export_bert_to_executorch: run optimum-cli to export a bert-base-uncased model to ExecuTorch format using the xnnpack recipe
export_bert_quantized: run optimum-cli to export a quantized bert model to ExecuTorch with 8da4w linear quantization
test_bert_fill_mask_xnnpack: run the fill-mask test for bert using the xnnpack recipe with ExecuTorchModelForMaskedLM
test_bert_fill_mask_portable: run the fill-mask test for bert using the portable recipe with ExecuTorchModelForMaskedLM
run_bert_inference_helper: run the helper method to load bert via ExecuTorchModelForMaskedLM and perform fill-mask inference
